title: Dilute anion alloyed III-nitride nanowires for photoelectrochemical water splitting
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, 4,699-707
DOI: 10.1039/D4YA00584H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
S. J. Calero-Barney, A. C. Nouduri, A. N. Andriotis, M. Menon, M. K. Sunkara
Dilute anion alloy nanowires of GaN, grown via plasma-assisted vapor–liquid–solid method with nitrogen and Au or Cu clusters, show ∼2 eV bandgap and excellent photoelectrochemical activity for unassisted water splitting and solar-chemical conversion.
